capabilities: Read notes aloud sentence by sentence from any clicked sentence
Highlight the current sentence during playback
Cache synthesized audio per sentence in IndexedDB
Batch-pregenerate audio for files and folders in a background queue
Configure multiple TTS provider accounts and switch between them
disambiguation: Not an audio recorder; it synthesizes speech from note text rather than capturing audio.
extras: The manifest carries the notice "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." The README is bilingual (Chinese with an English section) and includes developer deployment instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to have notes read aloud as continuous speech.

relations.evidence: Azure TTS (SSML with mixed-language <lang> spans for multilingual and HD voices, selectable output bitrate
Xiaomi MiMo TTS, and the built-in system voice as an offline fallback

requires.name: TTS provider account (OpenAI-compatible, Qwen3-TTS, Azure, or Xiaomi MiMo)

summary: Text-to-speech plugin that reads notes aloud sentence by sentence, with click-to-read, multi-provider TTS, prefetching and per-sentence caching.
